items.title: Should You Buy Amazon Stock For The Demand AWS Cannot Yet Serve?
items.summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) stock has returned 8.9% over the past twelve months and trades about 13% below its 52-week high. Its cloud arm spent those months doing something the share price has not reflected. AWS growth sped up again in Q2 2026, and the contracts queued up behind it kept building. The upside case for the stock rests almost entirely on turning that queue into revenue.

items.title: OpenAI’s CFO Just Explained Why Nvidia Is No Longer the Only Option
items.summary: OpenAI's CFO just revealed how $122 billion in cash fundamentally changes the power dynamic between the world's most important AI lab and its chip suppliers, and the implications for Nvidia's premium pricing are only beginning to surface.

items.title: Dan Niles Warns The the 10-Year Treasury Is Headed to 6%, A Level Not Seen Since The Height Of The Dot-Com Bubble
items.summary: The Fed has not moved its policy rate in months, yet long-term borrowing costs keep climbing on their own, and one prominent fund manager sees a level not touched since the dot-com era as the next stop, with serious consequences for mortgages, corporate debt, and equity multiples.

items.title: This AI Stock Could Be Worth Far More Than Investors Think
items.summary: Broadcom just posted AI revenue growth of 221% year over year and guided for even bigger numbers ahead, yet the stock sits well off its highs and trades at a fraction of its closest custom-chip rival's multiple. Something in that math does not add up.

items.title: Zuckerberg just picked a side in the AI slowdown fight
items.summary: The Meta CEO is siding with Nvidia's Jensen Huang as Silicon Valley argues over whether AI development should slow down.

items.title: Zuckerberg Says Labs Don't Need Permission to Slow Down
items.summary: Zuckerberg cited Meta's decision to delay the Muse agent without asking others to follow

items.title: Why Nvidia Stock Is Rising as Meta’s Zuckerberg Weighs In on AI Safety
items.summary: Nvidia stock is at risk if companies pause AI development. CEO Jensen Huang is determined to make sure that doesn't happen.

items.title: Why Meta's Zuckerberg, Nvidia's Huang Say An AI Slowdown Is Not Needed
items.summary: Leaders at the two tech giants do not support Anthropic's call for "pacing" AI development.
